notes.title: Name change: Paper Fire Rookie
notes.notes:
On 13 August 2019, "Paperville Panic" will be undergoing a name change to "Paper Fire Rookie"

Why?

Mini-game "Paper Fire Rookie Arcade" is available at over 200 VR arcades worldwide, and people are loving it <3 
That’s why we thought we’d simplify things and rename "Paperville Panic" to "Paper Fire Rookie" in Steam.

The game build has changed to reflect title / logo / credit updates to "Paper Fire Rookie". Existing Owners and wishlisters should see the game name in your library automatically update to reflect this change.  We hope you enjoy the new name update.

- The Ultimerse team

notes.title: Town Hall Level Update (Patch V0.9.2)
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW[/h1] 

[b]Brand New Level![/b] 
The Mayor has invited you to dinner at the Town Hall! What an honor! 
Explore this grand new level and learn more about the town of Paperville.

You can watch the level teaser  [url=https://youtu.be/YGygb73KCbM]here[/url].

[B]New Holster[/b]
Lookin' good, sailo- er, firefighter! 
Using the trigger you can equip and unequip your weapons and tools to your holster as you choose - select your preferred side too, so if you're a Leftorium shopper, this ones for you.

 [h1]IMPROVED[/h1] 
[list]
    [*] All weapons and tools now have haptic feedback! Rumble harder than a controller mid Smash combo. 
    [*] Haptic feedback when grabbing objects! You won't believe it's not hands!
    [*] We lowered the height of the light switch because apparently not everyone is Bigfoot.
    [*] Madame Firework's fight has been shortened slightly, after we realised she changed her code to have more stage time. #Diva
    [*] Holograms have been updated to reflect consistency in colours. 
    [*] Your Axe now returns to your holster faster! 
    [*] The citizen A.I. is smarter - improved navigation and facial animations! 
[/list] 

 [h1]BUG FIXES[/h1] 
    [*] Fixed a bug in Apartment where citizens were dipping into the floor when extinguished (a la Wizard of Oz Wicked Witch).
    [*] Performance improvements.
    [*] Fixed a bug in apartment where some fireballs couldn't be extinguished when fighting the boss.
    [*] Fixed a checkpoint bug in Podium where the player respawned and then was unable to teleport.
    [*] General bug fixes.

Hi everyone!

What's better than one demo?

TWO DEMOS!

We've added our PAX East exclusive demo to our demo download. If you'd like to see what PAX East was like, you can check out our recap video [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=toTbbvoikm0] here.[/url]

When playing the demo, you'll now load in with the option to select our original demo, or our new demo set in our upcoming convenience store level. (When we say Soon™, we mean [b]Soon[/b]™.)

The new demo is a little faster paced, so be prepared if you are new to VR! 

Otherwise, we've added the following:

- New loading screen for demo loader
- Visual improvements to original demo
- Performance improvements to demo 
- AI improvements to enemies
- Changes to gun mechanics 

Have fun! Paperville will be seeing a big update (maybe even with a special surprise SHHHH) soon! 

<3 Ultimerse

<3

Ultimerse

notes.title: Launch Week Is Here, AKA, What Year Is It?!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We hope you're as pumped for launch week as we are. Things have been zooming along at an insane pace here - even looking at the game this week compared to last is kind of crazy, because so much has improved and changed. 

We're working really hard to make sure that even though the game is early access at this stage, the content we release on day one feels super polished and enjoyable and comprehensive. If you want to keep up to date, we're across pretty much every social media platform, as well as our mailing list. We've also set up a subreddit at r/PapervillePanic, so if you're a frequent Redditor this might be your best option!

We've planned out all our approximate dates for all future content as well, so rest assured there are big plans for the next few months. We'll be outlining them after each release (e.g. when we go live, we'll post about what we're working on for the next update) and this will happen in detail over at our Subreddit as well.

We'll be launching with a discount, and I can say pretty safely that it's going to be the best and probably cheapest time to ever pick up Paperville. 

We'll see you on Thursday (or Wednesday, if you're on Murica-time!)

<3 Mez / Paperville Team

- There were a bunch of cockroaches and stuff. They're gone now.
[Minor bug fixes across the board!]

We hope the demo is even more enjoyable now.

<3 Meredith / The Paperville Team

@Ultimerse

Keep an eye out for that sometime this week. We hope you love it and keep in touch as we approach our upcoming December Early Access release - and if you encounter any bugs, please let us know!

Cheers <3

Meredith / The Paperville Team

(@Ultimerse)
